opening.argument: The description directly urges viewers to click an external link and join a paid mining pool, claiming that a $600 investment produced over $3,000 in two months and calling it “Very easy money and profitable.” Those claims turn the ordinary Coinbase wallet walkthrough into a solicitation for paid mining participation. The speaker reinforces that solicitation by identifying Bitcoin mining pools as his focus and offering a link to what he does. The claimed earnings and easy-money pitch establish the scam concern; the wallet tutorial does not remove that promotional purpose.
